whoItsFor: Developers who want an open-source AI coding agent that runs on their own machine, in a terminal, desktop app, browser, or editor, and who want to choose their own model provider. It suits tasks that read, edit, and run code inside a project folder with per-step approval.
useCases: Implement a task described in plain language, such as adding retry on failure to an HTTP client
Read and edit project files and run commands and tests inside a chosen project folder
Run tasks non-interactively in scripts with `reasonix run "task"`

requirements.runtime: Go ≥ 1.25 (CLI build from source); Node ≥ 24 and pnpm 10 (Studio build from source)
